method: Expert scripted UI review in native Godot 4.7.2 Metal Forward+ rendering. Pointer events pass through normal viewport input routing and actual menu controls. This is not a human novice playtest.
flow: Main menu → Campaign → First Orders briefing → Start → skip cinematic briefing
Find engineer → Command lab build button → occupied placement feedback → right-click cancellation without resource spending
Valid lab placement and actual construction → Find tank → Guard button and destination → capture lesson
Tactical pause freezes simulation; Find infantry still selects and pans during pause
Controlled loss of all tanks during Guard lesson → training guidance → shortcut selects a completed vehicle factory
Chinese language and 150% UI scale show the recovery lesson and controls without overlap
fixes: Required lesson instruction now precedes optional practical advice; each new lesson resets body scrolling.
Missing armor leads to completed vehicle-factory production, missing factory to engineer rebuilding, unfinished foundation to resuming construction, and missing engineers to HQ training.
Training shortcut skips unfinished factories and dead/deleting units; tank fallback names the vehicle factory.

Invalid structure placement now explains the reason in a compact localized screen-space panel, with readable 16-pixel base type, interface scaling, and viewport clamping. Valid placement and cancellation clear it; placement/resource rules are unchanged.
limits: Five real novice players and human comprehension/timing observations were not available.
The loss-of-armor recovery state is deliberately induced by the test; UI response and shortcut use normal input.
Only idle lab construction wait is accelerated to 4×; input interactions run at 1×.
New Chinese factory terminology was normalized from 载具工厂 to existing 车辆工厂 after the final capture, with identical character count; catalog regenerated.

minimum_viewport_check.observed: All required economy, Guard and capture instructions are visible above the fold. Lesson controls do not overlap minimap or unit menus.

placement_feedback_check.observed: All three panels are compact and clearly readable beside the invalid blueprint. Text stays inside the viewport and does not intercept pointer input. Normal right-click cancellation hides it.
placement_feedback_check.regression_scope: Invalid placement retains the blueprint without spending resources; valid placement hides the warning; Chinese occupied-ground feedback is localized; right-click cancellation clears the panel without spending resources.
